data.gender_notes: Alexandria is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Alexandria is recorded in name-lists as “Defender of mankind”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Alexandria expresses “Defender of mankind”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alexandria total 44, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_latin.name: Alexandria
in_latin.long_meaning: Alexandriae significatio, auctore Alexandro Magno, est nomen virtutum et scientiarum. Nomen Alexandrii significat virtus, sapientia, et scientia. In traditione Christiana, nomen Alexandriae significat ecclesia, sanctus, et fidelis.
